text:
mike_sales: Heads-up — ACME (enterprise) ~50M tokens/mo asking about mixing reserved capacity + prepaid credits. They want monthly billing, ability to offset overages with credits, and clarity on bursting penalties. @anya (product) any guidance?
anya (product): Thanks. Do we have their token profile (avg seq len) and split gen vs embeddings? Need tokens/mo + peak qps to model pricing.
mike_sales: Sent profile: 50M tokens, ~80% generation / 20% embeddings, typical peak 200 qps, bursts to ~800. They explicitly want the option to convert reserved -> dedicated mid-contract. Also asking if unused reserved can become credits.
jordan_support: FWIW ticket #4872 from BetaCorp had similar ask. Current behavior: reserved = commit; overages billed at on-demand *plus* 15% surcharge. Customers ask for rollover credits but we don't support it today.
leo_finance: Confirming current policy: overage_rate = on_demand_rate * 1.15. No rollover. We can propose a pilot for rollover credits but it'll need rev ops/legal signoff. Dedicated migration has pro-rate + migration fee today.
sam_pm: From product POV, propose we present ACME 3 options: 1) Standard reserved (no rollover) + overage at +15% 2) Reserved + prepaid credits that offset overages (new offering) 3) Dedicated migration path with pro-rated credits + migration discount. Need launch criteria: legal, billing, e2e billing tests. @leo_finance what approvals needed?
leo_finance: For pilot: SLA addendum, billing flow for credit offsets, and a cap on rollover exposure (e.g., 3 months). Also need contract language and UI visibility for credit balances. Revenue ops must sign off.
anya (product): Can someone paste sample invoice / line items? Engineering needs exact fields to map.
jordan_support: Sample from #4872:
```
Line item: reserved_capacity: 10000 GPU-hours, price: $X
Line item: usage_tokens: 52,345,210, price_per_token: $0.00002
Line item: overage_tokens: 2,345,210, surcharge: 15%
Credits_applied: 50,000
```
Also ACME asked for per-route rates (embedding vs generation).
mike_sales: ACME will push to allow credits to apply across hosted + dedicated if they move — that complicates accounting.
sam_pm: Intake checklist suggestion:
- capture tokens/mo + split
- desired billing cadence
- migration timeline + if they might go Dedicated
- legal/compliance constraints
I'll open a GH issue. If we want 'credits that offset overages' we need: billing flow changes, UI for credit balance, finance approval, docs, migration policy.
intake-bot: Ticket created: INTAKE-1221 (ACME pricing/credits). Assigned to @anya (product), @leo_finance, @sam_pm.
anya (product): :thumbsup: I'll draft a short RFC with options + risks. Can legal provide a sample clause for credit rollover? @mike_sales pls share ACME procurement timeline.
mike_sales: Procurement timeline: ~45 days. They want a draft by EOW.
leo_finance: I'll run revenue impact calc. If we reduce overage premium to 5% for a pilot, rough delta ~-$6k/mo for 50M tokens — will provide numbers.
sam_pm: Next steps: 1) product RFC by Friday, 2) finance impact calc, 3) legal clause draft. Keeping thread updated.
